title: A shopping cart
description:
Total a shopping cart with array methods.

```
Items: 3, units: 6
Subtotal: 23.50
Discount: 2.35
Total: 21.15
Most expensive line: Coffee (12.00)
```
hints: `cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.qty, 0)` adds up the lines.
`reduce` can also keep the best item so far: `(best, item) => item.price * item.qty > best.price * best.qty ? item : best`.
requirements: A cart is an array of `{ name, price, qty }`.
`subtotal(cart)` uses `reduce`. Carts over 20.00 get a 10% discount.
`priciest(cart)` returns the item whose `price * qty` is largest.
stretch: Write `removeItem(cart, name)` that returns a new array without changing the old one.
